title: Return, iii
logline: Wednesday. Gully's. 'Regular.' Nine months without the word. Gully pours before Wood sits. The stool has a dent where nine months of nobody sat.

panels.composition: Gully's door. WOOD in it with BARNABY. GULLY already pouring. MARIA at the register with the baby, a few months old.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with cleaner flats, a thin man and an old dog in a bait-shop doorway while a man in an apron already pours a coffee and a woman holds a baby at the register

panels.composition: The end stool. The seat's worn ring. A dent. Nine months.
props: the end stool, its worn ring

image.prompt: brush-pen line with cleaner flats, close-up of a worn wooden stool seat with a pale ring and a shallow dent, no words

panels.composition: Wood sitting. The dent fitting. Gully not looking at him. Maria looking at him, once, the two-finger look she gives the dog's leg.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with cleaner flats, a thin man sitting on a shop stool while a man in an apron avoids looking and a woman with a baby gives him one assessing look, no words

panels.composition: The baby's hand out toward the dog. The dog's nose up to it. Everyone watching that instead.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with cleaner flats, a baby reaching a hand toward an old dog's raised nose while the adults watch, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: 'Regular.' The dent in the stool. The baby and the dog.
